The rider did everything the platform asks: at 20:28:34 she sent a locating message naming her exact position ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A'), and the driver's only reply 'ok' came at 20:29:04, 30 seconds later but with no movement to that entrance before he cancelled at 20:32:36. Under POL-NS-03 limb (i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.

The rider's device was stationary within 12.03 m mean distance of the pickup pin for 47 fixes across the waiting window (rider_qualifying_fix_count 47 of 47), well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, so the rider was present and waiting at the pin throughout.

The fare ledger confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the full refund of the cancellation-fee line is the correct remedy and the amount is within the POL-GEN-05 automatic execution threshold.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against completed_trips_30d of 87, a rate of 0.023, which is below both the absolute count of 4 and the 0.08 rate in the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check, so no escalation is triggered on that limb and the fee is not held on that basis.

The driver therefore never arrived at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The driver's in-geofence dwell is zero seconds. The longest qualifying run inside the arrival radius is 0.0 seconds across 0 fixes, against a minimum dwell of 180 seconds for this STANDARD zone class. The waiting period the rider paid the fee for was never served, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present.

The driver's track shows him moving at speeds between 33.1 and 62.4 km/h across the trip, with a distinct 0.0 km/h entry only at the very end. A driver travelling at those speeds is not holding position at a pickup point; the trace is inconsistent with any stationary wait at the pin.

The rider's own track places her device within 9.1 to 14.8 m of the pickup pin for 47 fixes, all at 0.0 km/h, from 20:26:34 to 20:33:28. She was at the pickup point and stationary throughout the waiting window, which defeats any suggestion that the driver's failure to reach her was caused by her absence.

The rider sent a locating message at 20:28:34 naming her position ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A'). The driver's only reply was 'ok' at 20:29:04, and he cancelled at 20:32:36 without moving to the entrance she named. Under POL-NS-03 limb (i) the rider stated the correct entrance and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, so the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.

The trip record shows the driver cancelled under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 20:32:36, but the GPS trace establishes he was never within the arrival radius. The reason code is therefore mis-selected, and under POL-NS-01 the mis-selection is recorded as a driver-education item in the ruling's referrals.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged to the rider and remains CHARGED with no refund issued. Since the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06, the full SGD 4.50 must be refunded to the rider.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02711-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0. No advisory covers this pickup road, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot be invoked to accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals, and the driver cannot rely on a kerb restriction or enforcement operation to excuse the shortfall.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 against completed_trips_30d of 87, a rate of 0.023. This is below the POL-NS-07 anti-farming threshold of 4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08, so the anti-farming check does not trip and the case does not escalate on that ground.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0. Neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged, so there is no repeat-abuse pattern requiring escalation.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on TRP-02711 is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

Why the fee cannot stand. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02711, weight 1.0) never places him inside the 50 m arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup: qualifying in-geofence fixes = 0, longest in-geofence run = 0.0 s, and his closest approach to the pin at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 was 156.99 m. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02711, weight 1.0) shows the trip terminated by the driver at 20:32:36 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with a 4.4-minute wait timer running from his pressed arrival marker. Because the driver held position outside the 50 m arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, POL-NS-03 governs: he did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded in full. Independently, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force, so POL-NS-06 also requires the full refund, whether or not the rider was present.

Fault and the driver's money. The rider's device sat 9.1-14.8 m from the pin for all 47 of her fixes, and the chat log (EV-CHAT-02711, weight 1.0) shows her message at 20:28:34 naming 'the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A' and the driver's only reply 'ok' at 20:29:04, with no movement to her position before he cancelled 3.5 minutes later. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.25 does not apply: it needs two or more registered pickup points and neither party specifying a sub-location, and here registered_pickup_points is 1 and the rider did specify. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. driver_compensation_sgd is therefore null. The anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 87 completed trips in 30 days), and neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) is engaged (0 + 0 counterparty disputes; 0 no-show disputes in 30 days), so nothing is withheld or escalated.

Claim by claim, on the points that could change the outcome. Never arrived / zero dwell / fare of SGD 4.50 charged and unreconciled to any refund: accepted, and they carry the refund. Rider presence at the pin: accepted as fact, but POL-NS-04 does not itself exonerate her because the driver replied within 120 seconds, so limb (b) fails; the refund does not depend on that clause. False arrival marker (POL-NS-05) and the false-arrival referral that was asked for: not made out. The marker is a BUTTON press falling at the driver's closest approach, 157 m from the pin, inside the 300 m mark, and the record does not show him travelling at 15 km/h or above at that timestamp; POL-NS-05 expressly leaves a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03, so no false-arrival event is recorded in referrals. Recording the RIDER_NO_SHOW code as a driver-education referral (POL-NS-01): rejected. That referral is keyed to the driver's stationary fixes lying inside the arrival radius, and to a reason code outside the three limb (d) codes; here the fixes lie outside the radius and RIDER_NO_SHOW is a recognised limb (d) code, so the failure is limb (b), not limb (d).

The driver's statement that he 'was at the pickup as shown on the map' is outweighed by his own telemetry, which puts him no closer than 157 m at any point in the trip.

The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02711-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and is relied on by no finding; POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable, so no separate intervals can be summed. POL-GEN-02(2): the finding rests on EV-GPS-02711 and EV-TRIP-02711, both at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes on issue; this ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation: Rider and driver, this is decided on the driver's own GPS trace. The trip was accepted at 20:22:12 and cancelled by the driver at 20:32:36 under the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The trace EV-GPS-02711 runs from 20:22:14 to 20:33:44 at 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps, and it never once puts the car inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3: the derived arrival block reports qualifying_fix_count = 0 and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 seconds, and the closest the car ever came to the pickup pin across the whole trip was 156.99 m. Under POL-NS-02 the three-consecutive-in-radius-fix test is therefore not met, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. It makes no difference that the record shows an 'arrived' tap at 20:28:14 and a 4.4-minute wait timer: those are the driver's own status entries, and POL-NS-02 reads position, not the tap. Independently, POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a shortfall of 180 seconds, whether or not the rider was present. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02711-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the driver cannot accumulate any dwell across separate intervals or excuse the shortfall on kerb-restriction grounds. The arrival marker is also a false one: the trace's recorded speeds are either 0.0 km/h (the final readings, after the 20:32:36 cancellation) or between 33.1 and 62.4 km/h, so at the 20:28:14 marker the car was in motion on the road well above the 15 km/h threshold in POL-NS-05, and there is no in-geofence fix at or before that timestamp; under POL-NS-05 the marker does not start the waiting clock, and because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) gives the full refund, no compensation, and the false-arrival record I have placed in the referrals. On the driver's statement 'I was at the pickup as shown on the map': the map is in the record and it shows the opposite, and a statement carries no weight multiplier and cannot satisfy the 50 m test the clause sets. On the rider's contact: her message at 20:28:34 did name her position, but the driver replied 'ok' at 20:29:04, 30 seconds later, so POL-NS-04 limb (b) fails and that clause cannot operate here — her recorded presence (47 fixes, all at 0.0 km/h, a mean of 12.03 m from the pin) is not needed for the refund and does not change it. If this is instead treated as a wrong-face-of-the-pin case under POL-NS-03, the closest approach of 156.99 m is inside the 400 m ceiling, and the same result follows: the rider named the 'main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A' and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, so the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.
